en.text: Say from “Like a father hath compassion,” until “when we call,” page 9, then say the verses “For we do not presume,” and “O Lord, hear,” pp. 9, 10.

unresolved_expansion: English includes Daniel verse pair before the separately printed full Daniel passage; Hebrew cue stops before that pair.
